dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: ...Only focusing on the win won't get you over the finish line. And that's a terribly narrow way to measure life, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Just look at me... I've lost an avenue of honest work and my wife's tender loving care, but I've won it all back in the tranquility that fishing brings me...
